checks.title: Every day has a record for every sub-step that should have run, and none for any that should not
Every turn ends on a day that is a business day somewhere and covers every day since the last turn
read-trace found no undeclared read, no read of a later write and no duplicate stream open
Every record is dated with the day and sub-step that wrote it

checks.detail: it compared the world with a second run of it; the world runs once, and determinism is carried by construction
checks.title: The world hash is the same whatever the worker count

checks.detail: it compared the world with a second run of it; canonical handler ids carry it by construction
checks.title: The world hash is the same whatever the registration order

checks.detail: it compared the world with a second run of it; observers reach the world only through &self
checks.title: Looking at the world changes nothing

checks.detail: it compared the world with a second run of it; a stream's key comes from its own name alone
checks.title: Adding a stream changes no other stream's draws
Every close ran every declared audit family, and they found nothing

checks.detail: an injection needs a save loaded apart, and saves arrive with persistence (S0.20)
checks.title: Each family's injection into the day-30 save lights that family alone
The surface is closed, every tile with eight neighbours that count it back; every land tile's zone is in one region and country; every region has land; every site lies in its country and region
The rejection record lists every failed attempt with its condition; the accepted map meets every condition
Each region's realised weather is within z = 6.1 of its declared climate for the month, adjusted for persistence
Catastrophe frequencies per hazard are within z = 6.1 of their declared rates over the run
For every finite deposit, extracted plus remaining equals its opening quantity
For every issued instrument, holdings sum to the issued amount
Every line's two sides hold equal counts, and each side it lists equals its holders' rows
Per issuer and currency, the balances held equal its money liability; the notes held equal the notes issued
Every instruction's paired legs sum to nothing per denomination; transformations and opening writes name their sources
Per holder and asset per day, what it held plus what came in less what went out is what it holds
Every fail has a cause, and its line kind's contract process recorded it at 2d
Gross and net settlement, fails by cause and the closing ring are published every day
Day one passes every family
The GEN report lists every opening write with party, amount and identity, and each distribution with its source
Every opening contract's payments fall on business days by its convention
Payments fall due and are processed every business day, and every fail has a cause
Every bank's reserve movement equals the net of its customers' applied payments
The settled set is sound and maximal, recomputed on the state at the start of stage 7

checks.detail: the first levy arrives with the taxes (S1.11)
checks.title: Sampled levy amounts equal per member times count under their conventions
On sampled holders, every row due was read in the holder's run, and no head was later than its segment's earliest due day
